d73c2247d8.q: What is the difference between generative AI and agentic AI for small business workflows?
d73c2247d8.a: Generative AI like ChatGPT and Claude responds to prompts and stops after generating a single output, while agentic AI is a series of generative tools completing multi-step workflows where the agent has decision-making power. True agentic systems can autonomously analyze data, make judgments based on frameworks you provide, and execute tasks like choosing between ad variations and implementing them, whereas many tools called 'agents' are simply task-passing systems that speed up workflows without autonomous decision-making.

0aa0d2f64f.q: What are practical first use cases for AI agents in email marketing for small businesses?
0aa0d2f64f.a: Email marketing is a strong first use case because it involves multiple steps: concept, copy, design, and segmentation. You can train Claude on your brand voice, mission, and customer data to generate first drafts that your team reviews, or use tools like Klaviyo or PostScript with MCP integrations that allow Claude to analyze your historical email performance, open rates, click rates, and conversion data, then autonomously write and schedule email sequences for campaigns like Black Friday or the upcoming year.

df7c1a99dc.q: How should a small business owner prepare context before using AI tools for projects?
df7c1a99dc.a: Before opening ChatGPT or Claude, create a document with everything about your business: what you sell, who your customers are, your goals for the year, and business bottlenecks you're struggling with, because context is king and output is only as good as input. Piper recommends creating a personal constitution or markdown file by having Claude ask you questions about your personal and professional goals, values, habits you want to break, and your relationship with employees and customers—ideally in a one-hour voice conversation with Claude that generates this document.

ed1604e8b4.q: Why do many people overclaim the number of AI agents they are running in their business?
ed1604e8b4.a: Many tools are called agents but are not truly agentic systems—they may be really good generative tools that do copywriting or planning, or task-passing systems that speed up workflows, but they do not have autonomous decision-making power. Piper advises skeptically asking LinkedIn posters claiming to have 52 agents what each agent specifically does and what decisions it makes; often you will find they are just using generative tools, which is still valuable but technically not true agents.

9f39512602.q: What is MCP and how does it enable AI tools to integrate with email platforms?
9f39512602.a: MCP is a backend integration that allows Claude or ChatGPT to connect with email platforms like Klaviyo, PostScript, or MailChimp so you can ask questions about your email campaigns without opening the provider itself. With MCP, an AI tool can not only read information like open rates and conversion data, but also write, meaning it can build workflows, create segments, schedule emails, and even hit send autonomously.
